verdict.rationale: Factory documents a way to view plan usage: open Settings > Usage or run `/limits` in Droid, on its pricing page. Team-level consumption tracking is also claimed. Nothing in the pack says these limits are daily task caps or concurrency caps, or that a lead can configure or manage them. Missing for 10: documented daily task limits, documented concurrency limits for agent workflows, controls to manage or adjust limits per plan or team, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows

citations.quote: Monitor usage: open **Settings > Usage** or run `/limits` in Droid.
Track adoption and consumption per developer and per team, with real-time usage metrics and exportable reports.
